name: Trent Ltd
about: Trent Ltd is engaged in retailing of apparels, footwear, accessories, toys, games, food, grocery & non food products through various of its retail formats/ concepts.[1]
keyPoints: Part of Tata Group:[1] The company is a part of the Tata Group with ~37% of group shareholding, 32.5% with Tata Sons Private Ltd & 4.3% with Tata Investment Corporation Ltd. [2] Tata Group comprises 100 operating companies in 7 business sectors. The group operates in over 80 countries across 6 continents.
pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 110% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 26.0%
Company's median sales growth is 24.0% of last 10 years
cons: Stock is trading at 20.1 times its book value

announcements.text: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation 20 Nov - Trent schedules analyst/investor meetings Nov 26–Dec 9, 2026, including Canararobeco, Capital Group, Millenium, HSBC.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation 17 Nov - Intimation of schedule of Analyst / Institutional Investors Meetings
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Credit Rating 16 Nov - CARE reaffirmed Trent’s commercial paper rating A1+ on ₹750 crore limit, up from ₹500 crore, on 16 Nov 2026.
Reminder Letter To Shareholders To Dematerialise The Shares 13 Nov - Trent issued a 13 Nov 2026 reminder to shareholders to dematerialise physical shares.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation 9 Nov - Trent announces analyst and institutional investor meetings from 17-26 November 2026.
